description_en: Modifies an Edge Private Network (EPN) instance
description_zh: 调用ModifyEpnInstance修改边边通信实例
name: ModifyEpnInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the EPN instance
parameters.name: epn_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the EPN instance
parameters.name: epn_instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The networking mode. Valid values:

SpeedUp: Intelligent acceleration network (Internet).

Connection: Internal network.

SpeedUpAndConnection: Intelligent acceleration network and internal network.

The internal network supports only Connection and SpeedUpAndConnection
parameters.help_zh:
组网模式，取值：
SpeedUp：智能加速（外网）。
Connection：内网联通（内网模式）。
SpeedUpAndConnection：智能加速及内网联通（内网模式）。

内网模式只能在Connection和SpeedUpAndConnection之间进行切换
parameters.name: networking_model

parameters.help_en: The maximum outbound public bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values: 1 Mbit/s to 100 Mbit/s
parameters.help_zh: 公网出带宽最大值，单位为Mbit/s。取值范围：1Mbit/s～100Mbit/s
parameters.name: internet_max_bandwidth_out
